Details 
 Comfortable and dependable, the Wrangler® performance long-sleeve plaid button-up is the perfect shirt for work, play, and everything in between. This classic fit shirt comes with a back vent, UV protection, and a moisture-wicking finish to keep you feeling cool and dry when the elements have different plans. Need space to store your essentials? Double chest pockets, a dedicated pencil slot, and a zippered Napoleon-style pocket have you covered. Plus, it features sleeve keepers for versatility and a glasses cleaner at the hem to keep you smudge-free. Try this classic plaid shirt with your favorite pair of Wrangler jeans to take on the day in style.
- Fit: Classic
- Sleeve Length: Long
- Sleeve: Roll Tab
- Front Closure: Buttons
- Front Pockets: Four secure zip Napoleon pockets with button-through
- Back: Authentic Western Back Yoke
- Collar: Hidden Button Down
- Waist Hem: Glasses Cleaner at Hem
